merge_support_docs: merge slices of collected support documents from a directory into a single deduplicated JSON file
finalize_slices: finalize collected documents by splitting them into 3000-document slices and writing slice JSON files
run_merge_mode: run the script with a dataset name and category to merge support docs into a JSON file
run_finalize_mode: run the script with finalize as the second argument to slice collected documents into chunks
review_merge_logic: review the merge_support_docs function that deduplicates articles by URL and groups them by ELI5 key
